messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events. If the event bus is down, the webhook dispatcher is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. The Boreal team kept it until today.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: The event bus remains a Boreal service.
- [2025-02-20] standup/boreal/2025-02-20: Decided in today's standup: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, since the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-02-25] standup/boreal/2025-02-25: Webhooks still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. Boreal still owns the catalog service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: For the record, the event bus is owned by Boreal.
- [2026-03-04] standup/dune/2026-03-04: The webhook dispatcher remains a team Dune service.
- [2025-02-27] standup/boreal/2025-02-27: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation. Team Boreal noticed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. We decided that notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-04-08] standup/dune/2025-04-08: Reminder that the reporting service depends on the ledger.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Boreal saw that the bus' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-17] handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction: The 2025-11-07 note about the reporting service named the wrong team. The Ember team took it over on that date; team Boreal did not.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04-2: As before, the webhook dispatcher needs the event bus to work. Reminder: webhooks is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-03-17] standup/atlas/2025-03-17: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-03-28] handover/2025-03-28-webhooks: From today the pager for the webhooks service rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-11-20] handover/2025-11-20-event-bus: Boreal is taking over the bus from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10-2: Observation from team Dune: after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. The webhook dispatcher deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-17] standup/boreal/2025-03-17: Reminder that webhooks only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-06-12] standup/dune/2025-06-12: The Dune team noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-05-23] standup/ember/2025-05-23: The Ember team saw that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-05-05] standup/boreal/2025-05-05: Reminder that the billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27-2: Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10: Dependency map update: the billing service needs the ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2: Atlas saw that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change; not their service, so they flagged it. The Atlas team noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.

Question: Which service depends on the notifier?

Looking through entries:

- Webhooks relies on bus.
- Reporting depends on ledger.
- Auth gateway down → ledger down.
- Billing needs ledger.
- Billing-api needs feature-flags.
- Webhook dispatcher needs event bus.

I don't see any entry stating that some service depends on the notifier. There are observations about notifier's CPU, memory, request volume, but nothing that says a service depends on the notifier.

So the answer is "I don't know".
